feature_sets.A: normalized pad/component coordinates + pair distance/direction only
feature_sets.B: A + 18-class one-hot component labels and unordered component-pair interaction
feature_sets.C: B + component-relative/local-frame pad coordinates, pin-count, local density, rotation/facing proxies

model: LightGBM; same training sampler and same validation-selected mutual Top-K transitive clustering for A/B/C
caveat: Face direction uses component rotation as a proxy; true pad normals and photo-derived traces are unavailable.
interpretation: These are same-net candidate probabilities. They do not mean direct physical copper adjacency; review high-confidence links before treating them as a netlist.
